# BTicino C300X Integration v1.8.2

## Fixed

- Keep HA Cloud on-demand WebRTC sessions alive across short transient
  `disconnected` ICE states instead of closing the card immediately.

## Upgrade Notes

- Restart Home Assistant after updating.
- Hard-reload all open Home Assistant browser dashboards after updating so the
  bundled frontend modules are refreshed from the installed integration
  version.
- The native C300X device agent is unchanged from `1.8.1`; no agent update is
  required for this frontend-only fix.
